emotions.definition: Strong displeasure, irritation, rage, resentment, or hostility.

archetypes.name: Riot and Protest
archetypes.core_difference: Focuses on collective, outdoor socio-political rage rather than individual frustration, distinguishing it from fear by the presence of active, forward-moving confrontation rather than retreat.
archetypes.visual_elements: aggressive crowd, clenched fists, shouting faces, smoke, barricade, gritty lighting
archetypes.text_query: A volatile street protest captured with gritty high-contrast lighting, where an aggressive crowd of demonstrators with clenched fists and shouting faces confronts a barricade amidst smoke and chaotic urban debris.

archetypes.name: Domestic Argument
archetypes.core_difference: Highlights intense interpersonal hostility in an intimate setting, differing from sadness by featuring tense, outward aggression rather than withdrawn sorrow.
archetypes.visual_elements: dim kitchen, pointing fingers, glaring, furrowed brows, scattered papers, tense posture
archetypes.text_query: Shot from a low angle in a dimly lit kitchen, two people stand with tense body language, pointing fingers and glaring at each other with furrowed brows during a heated domestic dispute over scattered papers.

archetypes.name: Sports Frustration
archetypes.core_difference: Isolates explosive physical frustration related to competition and failure, separating it from the biological repulsion of disgust.
archetypes.visual_elements: stadium grass, scowling athlete, rigid muscles, slamming equipment, daylight
archetypes.text_query: An athlete kneels on the brightly lit stadium grass, slamming a piece of sports equipment onto the ground with a scowling face and rigid muscles after a devastating referee call interrupts the daytime game.

archetypes.name: Road Rage
archetypes.core_difference: Captures enclosed, situational irritation behind a barrier, distinct from neutral commuting scenes through visible facial flushing and aggressive yelling.
archetypes.visual_elements: rain-streaked windshield, red face, gripping steering wheel, shouting, brake lights, traffic
archetypes.text_query: Framed closely through a rain-streaked windshield, a highly frustrated driver grips the steering wheel tightly, yelling aggressively with a red face at the standstill traffic gridlock illuminated by harsh brake lights.

archetypes.name: Evoked Vandalism
archetypes.core_difference: Presents scene-level evidence of hostility without human subjects present, evoking anger through destruction rather than the melancholy decay found in sadness.
archetypes.visual_elements: defaced monument, red graffiti, broken glass, public plaza, flat lighting
archetypes.text_query: Captured in a flat documentary style, a public monument stands defaced with aggressive red graffiti and broken glass strewn across the surrounding plaza, evoking a strong sense of hostility and senseless destruction.

archetypes.name: Animal Aggression
archetypes.core_difference: Shows territorial instinct and biological threat displays in wildlife, distinguished from fear by mutual offensive posturing rather than one-sided fleeing.
archetypes.visual_elements: bared teeth, flattened ears, raised hackles, savanna, dominant predators, midday sun
archetypes.text_query: A close-up wildlife photograph captures two dominant predators in a dry savanna environment, showing bared teeth, flattened ears, and raised hackles as they aggressively dispute territory under the blazing midday sun.

emotions.definition: Revulsion, aversion, contamination response, or strong dislike.

archetypes.name: Rotting Food
archetypes.core_difference: Emphasizes biological decay and contamination at a macro scale, lacking the active interpersonal hostility of anger or the dread of fear.
archetypes.visual_elements: decaying fruit, green mold, fruit flies, cracked table, harsh overhead lighting
archetypes.text_query: A macro photograph reveals a bowl of severely decaying fruit covered in thick green mold and swarming fruit flies, sitting neglected on a cracked wooden table under harsh fluorescent overhead lighting.

archetypes.name: Environmental Pollution
archetypes.core_difference: Evokes widespread, scene-level aversion through industrial toxicity, contrasting with the melancholic atmosphere of sadness by emphasizing chemical blight and sludge.
archetypes.visual_elements: toxic river, plastic waste, chemical foam, dead fish, muddy banks, overcast sky
archetypes.text_query: A wide-angle landscape shot depicts a stagnant, toxic river choked with plastic waste, industrial chemical foam, and dead fish floating along the muddy banks under a gloomy, overcast grey sky.

archetypes.name: Facial Revulsion
archetypes.core_difference: Captures the classic human micro-expression of recoil and nose-pinching, differentiating it from surprise by the clear negative valence and avoidance behavior.
archetypes.visual_elements: bathroom mirror, pinched nose, pulled back lips, grimace, soiled clothing
archetypes.text_query: In a brightly lit bathroom mirror reflection, a person pinches their nose and pulls their lips back in a distinct grimace of revulsion while holding up a heavily soiled, unidentifiable piece of discarded clothing.

archetypes.name: Vermin Infestation
archetypes.core_difference: Focuses on the visceral aversion to pests and urban filth, distinct from neutral street photography due to the concentrated presence of sludge and insects.
archetypes.visual_elements: cockroaches, rodents, overflowing dumpster, dark sludge, stark flash, urban alleyway
archetypes.text_query: Captured with stark flash photography in a dark urban alleyway, a swarm of large cockroaches and rodents scavenges through an overflowing, severely stained garbage dumpster leaking dark sludge onto the pavement.

archetypes.name: Medical Gore
archetypes.core_difference: Highlights bodily contamination and infection in a clinical setting, separated from fear by the focus on the wound itself rather than a threatening medical instrument.
archetypes.visual_elements: festering wound, yellow discharge, surgical lights, clinical close-up, sterile environment
archetypes.text_query: A clinical close-up framed under sterile surgical lights focuses on a deeply infected, festering skin wound with yellow discharge, evoking an immediate visceral response of bodily contamination and biological aversion.

archetypes.name: Unsanitary Living
archetypes.core_difference: Displays extreme domestic neglect and filth, distinct from sadness (which might show tidy poverty) by emphasizing feces, hoarding, and gross contamination.
archetypes.visual_elements: hoarding debris, stained carpets, peeling wallpaper, cobwebs, dusty sunlight, boarded windows
archetypes.text_query: A wide interior shot shows an abandoned, deeply unsanitary living room filled with hoarding debris, feces-stained carpets, peeling wallpaper, and cobwebs, illuminated by weak shafts of dusty sunlight filtering through boarded windows.

emotions.definition: Alarm, anxiety, perceived danger, threat, horror, or vulnerability.

archetypes.name: Intruding Threat
archetypes.core_difference: Highlights immediate physical danger and hiding behavior, fundamentally distinct from surprise by the sustained, agonizing dread of an approaching predator or attacker.
archetypes.visual_elements: blue moonlight, crouched homeowner, trembling hands, wide eyes, shadowed silhouette, bedroom door
archetypes.text_query: Illuminated only by the eerie blue glow of moonlight, a terrified homeowner hides crouched behind a bedroom door, eyes wide and hands trembling, while a shadowed silhouette stands menacingly in the hallway.

archetypes.name: Immense Natural Disaster
archetypes.core_difference: Portrays overwhelming environmental danger triggering mass panic, separating it from the sadness of post-disaster ruins by showing the threat actively unfolding.
archetypes.visual_elements: massive tornado, abandoned vehicles, desperate panic, rural highway, ominous green storm sky
archetypes.text_query: A dramatic wide shot captures a massive, dark tornado tearing across a rural highway, while drivers abandon their vehicles in a desperate panic against the backdrop of an ominous, green-tinted storm sky.

archetypes.name: Acrophobia
archetypes.core_difference: Induces visceral dread via a point-of-view perspective of a lethal drop, uniquely utilizing depth and height to convey vulnerability without a living antagonist.
archetypes.visual_elements: downward perspective, glass-bottomed deck, trembling feet, precipitous drop, vertigo
archetypes.text_query: Shot from a dizzying, downward-facing perspective on a glass-bottomed observation deck, trembling feet stand hesitantly at the edge of a precipitous drop, vividly conveying a visceral sense of vertigo and acute vulnerability.

archetypes.name: Predator Pursuit
archetypes.core_difference: Captures the frantic anxiety of the hunted in nature, distinct from animal anger by highlighting flight, desperation, and defensive vulnerability.
archetypes.visual_elements: sprinting deer, stalking wolf, motion blur, dense shadowy forest, underbrush
archetypes.text_query: A motion-blurred action photograph in a dense, shadowy forest shows a frantic deer sprinting desperately through the underbrush, closely pursued by a stalking wolf with locked gaze and predatory intent.

archetypes.name: Eerie Atmosphere
archetypes.core_difference: Evokes horror and foreboding purely through scene composition and lighting, contrasting with disgust by focusing on the supernatural and the unseen rather than biological decay.
archetypes.visual_elements: fog-shrouded cemetery, crooked headstones, skeletal trees, dark figure, monochrome, mist
archetypes.text_query: A desolate, fog-shrouded cemetery is captured in monochrome, featuring crooked headstones, withered skeletal trees, and a mysterious dark figure barely visible in the mist, projecting a deep atmosphere of dread and foreboding.

archetypes.name: Medical Anxiety
archetypes.core_difference: Demonstrates anticipatory anxiety and phobia in a clinical setting, differentiated from sadness by the child's alarmed, wide-eyed focus on an impending noxious stimulus.
archetypes.visual_elements: tearful child, shrinking back, wide eyes, large needle, pale face, sterile white room
archetypes.text_query: In a sterile white clinical room, a tearful child shrinks back into a medical chair with a pale, alarmed face, staring with wide eyes at the large vaccination needle held by an approaching nurse.

emotions.definition: Happiness, delight, pleasure, playful enjoyment, or celebration.

archetypes.name: Grand Celebration
archetypes.core_difference: Features high-arousal mass euphoria and festivity, distinct from the sudden jolt of surprise by the sustained, communal nature of the positive affect.
archetypes.visual_elements: cheering crowd, raised hands, beaming smiles, fireworks display, dark sky, vibrant festival
archetypes.text_query: A vibrant nighttime festival is bursting with energy, as a massive crowd of cheering people with raised hands and beaming smiles watches a spectacular, colorful fireworks display illuminating the dark sky above.

archetypes.name: Intimate Affection
archetypes.core_difference: Captures low-arousal, profound familial contentment, separating itself from neutral domestic scenes through explicit smiling, warmth, and gentle physical connection.
archetypes.visual_elements: warm sunlight, living room rug, young couple laughing, toddler playing, golden retriever
archetypes.text_query: Bathed in warm, golden afternoon sunlight, a young couple sits comfortably on a cozy living room rug, laughing joyously as their toddler playfully tackles a floppy-eared golden retriever.

archetypes.name: Personal Triumph
archetypes.core_difference: Expresses the specific joy of athletic victory and overcoming a challenge, contrasting with anger's sports frustration by featuring open, upward, victorious body language.
archetypes.visual_elements: snowy mountain summit, blue sky, victorious pose, raised arms, smiling hiker
archetypes.text_query: Standing proudly on a snowy mountain summit against a brilliant blue sky, an exhausted but elated hiker throws both arms upward in a victorious pose, smiling brightly after completing the arduous climb.

archetypes.name: Idyllic Landscape
archetypes.core_difference: Evokes pleasure strictly through natural beauty and color harmony, distinguished from neutral landscapes by the exceptionally vibrant, uplifting palette and perfect weather cues.
archetypes.visual_elements: spring meadow, yellow wildflowers, butterflies, lush green grass, clear sun-drenched sky
archetypes.text_query: A vibrant spring meadow stretches toward the horizon, filled with blooming yellow wildflowers, fluttering butterflies, and lush green grass swaying under a perfectly clear, sun-drenched sky, evoking pure scenic tranquility and delight.

archetypes.name: Playful Animals
archetypes.core_difference: Demonstrates uninhibited frolicking and physical play in animals, distinctly differing from neutral catalog pet shots via dynamic motion and sparkling environmental interaction.
archetypes.visual_elements: energetic puppies, splashing puddle, flopping ears, sparkling water droplets, crisp morning light
archetypes.text_query: A high-speed, brightly lit photograph freezes the moment two energetic puppies joyfully splash through a shallow backyard puddle, ears flopping and water droplets sparkling in the crisp morning light.

archetypes.name: Social Dining
archetypes.core_difference: Focuses on shared laughter and camaraderie over food, avoiding the mundane atmosphere of a neutral routine by emphasizing genuine smiles and a warm ambiance.
archetypes.visual_elements: lively restaurant, diverse friends, hearty laugh, large pizza, colorful drinks, string lights
archetypes.text_query: Candidly framed across a lively restaurant table, a diverse group of friends shares a hearty, joyful laugh over a large pizza and colorful drinks, surrounded by the warm, inviting ambiance of string lights.

emotions.definition: Sorrow, unhappiness, grief, loss, loneliness, or disappointment.

archetypes.name: Grief and Mourning
archetypes.core_difference: Directly confronts profound, irreversible loss and weeping, distinguishing it from fear by the absence of immediate threat and the posture of surrender.
archetypes.visual_elements: somber dark clothing, kneeling figure, rain-slicked gravestone, buried face, wilted rose, overcast sky
archetypes.text_query: A grieving person dressed in somber dark clothing kneels beside a rain-slicked gravestone, burying their face in their hands while holding a single wilted rose beneath a heavy, overcast grey sky.

archetypes.name: Urban Isolation
archetypes.core_difference: Evokes loneliness and disconnection through vast empty space around a solitary figure, differentiated from neutral public spaces by the slouched posture and cold lighting.
archetypes.visual_elements: solitary figure, slouched posture, desolate bus stop, wet pavement, flickering streetlight, late night
archetypes.text_query: A solitary figure sits slouched on a desolate bus stop bench late at night, staring blankly at the wet pavement illuminated by a flickering, cold streetlight in an otherwise empty urban landscape.

archetypes.name: Disaster Loss
archetypes.core_difference: Displays the sorrowful aftermath of tragedy, contrasting with fear's active disaster archetype by showing exhaustion, bowed heads, and the finality of ruin.
archetypes.visual_elements: displaced family, charred ruins, burned-down house, bowed heads, exhaustion, settling ash
archetypes.text_query: Framed in a bleak documentary style, a displaced family stands silently amidst the charred wooden ruins of their burned-down house, their heads bowed in exhaustion and profound despair as ash settles around them.

archetypes.name: Childhood Disappointment
archetypes.core_difference: Focuses on a smaller-scale, deeply felt personal deflation, separated from anger by the absence of acting out and the presence of retreating, hugging body language.
archetypes.visual_elements: shadowy floor, tear-streaked cheeks, hugging knees, broken toy, neglected balloon, downcast eyes
archetypes.text_query: Sitting alone on a shadowy bedroom floor, a young boy with tear-streaked cheeks hugs his knees tightly, looking down in deep disappointment beside a broken toy and a neglected birthday balloon.

archetypes.name: Melancholy Landscape
archetypes.core_difference: Projects sorrow onto a desolate natural setting through pathetic fallacy, fundamentally different from neutral landscapes due to the use of barren elements and weeping weather.
archetypes.visual_elements: barren tree, misty moor, withered brown grass, heavy fog, sunless sky
archetypes.text_query: A deeply melancholic landscape shows a single barren tree standing on a misty, desolate moor, surrounded by withered brown grass and heavy fog rolling in under a perpetually weeping, sunless sky.

archetypes.name: Animal Distress
archetypes.core_difference: Captures resignation and captivity in an animal subject, distinguishing it from neutral pet photography through droopy features and the gloomy shelter context.
archetypes.visual_elements: stray dog, chain-link fence, dim animal shelter, droopy eyes, flattened ears, resignation
archetypes.text_query: A heartbreaking, close-up portrait of a stray dog behind the chain-link fence of a dimly lit animal shelter, looking directly at the camera with droopy eyes, flattened ears, and a posture of complete resignation.

emotions.definition: A sudden reaction to something unexpected, novel, or startling.

archetypes.name: Unexpected Celebration
archetypes.core_difference: Captures the exact moment of a positive shock, differentiated from pure joy by the open mouth, covered face, and the emphasis on the sudden transition.
archetypes.visual_elements: open mouth, hands covering face, wide eyes, confetti, balloons, sudden illumination
archetypes.text_query: A young woman covers her open mouth with both hands in pure astonishment, her eyes wide as she walks into a dark living room suddenly illuminated by friends jumping out with confetti and balloons.

archetypes.name: Startling Accident
archetypes.core_difference: Highlights a neutral or slightly negative workplace jolt, distinct from anger or fear because the emotion is pure reflex to a sudden, harmless structural failure.
archetypes.visual_elements: office worker, jolting backward, raised eyebrows, collapsing file folders, neat desk, action shot
archetypes.text_query: Caught in a perfectly timed action shot, an office worker jolts backward in their chair with eyebrows raised in shock as a towering stack of file folders suddenly collapses onto their neat desk.

archetypes.name: Novelty and Disbelief
archetypes.core_difference: Focuses on collective awe and cognitive dissonance rather than an acoustic startle, uniquely showing people trying to process an impossible sight.
archetypes.visual_elements: diverse crowd, dropped jaws, wide eyes, street magician, levitating object, sunny street
archetypes.text_query: A diverse crowd of onlookers on a sunny pedestrian street exhibits exaggerated expressions of sheer disbelief, with dropped jaws and wide eyes, as a street magician successfully levitates an everyday object in mid-air.

archetypes.name: Sudden Weather Event
archetypes.core_difference: Features an involuntary physical flinch to a loud environmental trigger, distinguishing it from fear by emphasizing the immediate, frozen startle rather than ongoing panic.
archetypes.visual_elements: startled hiker, hunched shoulders, pulled in neck, looking up, massive lightning bolt, twilight sky
archetypes.text_query: A startled hiker on a rocky trail freezes with shoulders hunched and neck pulled in, looking up in abrupt alarm as a massive, unexpected bolt of lightning suddenly splits the twilight sky overhead.

archetypes.name: Surreal Imagery
archetypes.core_difference: Evokes a double-take in the viewer through physics-defying visual anomalies, totally devoid of human subjects and functioning purely as an evoked expectation violation.
archetypes.visual_elements: architectural photograph, upside-down house, grassy lawn, physics-defying, clear details
archetypes.text_query: An incredibly surreal architectural photograph shows a standard residential house that has been constructed entirely upside down, forcing the viewer to do a double-take at the physics-defying roof resting on the grassy lawn.

archetypes.name: Animal Startle
archetypes.core_difference: Captures the rigid, sensory-overload response of an animal to an unexpected noise, fundamentally distinct from neutral cat portraits via extreme pupillary dilation and a puffed tail.
archetypes.visual_elements: domestic cat, dilated pupils, stiff upright ears, fluffed tail, tiled floor, fluorescent lights
archetypes.text_query: A close-up shot of a domestic cat reacting to a sudden noise, featuring maximally dilated pupils, upright stiff ears, and a fluffed-up tail, standing frozen on a tiled kitchen floor under bright fluorescent lights.

emotions.definition: Emotionally balanced or low-arousal content without a dominant positive or negative affect.

archetypes.name: Relaxed Portrait
archetypes.core_difference: Presents a human face entirely free of affective tension, smiles, or grimaces, clearly lacking the emotional intensity that defines the other six classes.
archetypes.visual_elements: studio headshot, relaxed facial muscles, level gaze, no smile, plain grey background
archetypes.text_query: A professional studio headshot captures a softly lit adult looking directly at the camera with relaxed facial muscles, a level gaze, and no distinct smile, set against a plain, medium-grey seamless background.

archetypes.name: Ordinary Workspace
archetypes.core_difference: Documents an empty human environment in a clean, functional state, distinct from sadness's isolation by being a normal, well-lit setting devoid of melancholic cues.
archetypes.visual_elements: open-plan office, organized cubicles, blank monitors, mesh chairs, potted plants, bright lighting
archetypes.text_query: A brightly lit, contemporary open-plan office contains several organized cubicles featuring blank computer monitors, ergonomic mesh chairs, and simple potted plants, depicting a standard, functional work environment devoid of any human activity.

archetypes.name: Quiet Public Place
archetypes.core_difference: Observes people engaging in passive, everyday transit without conflict, joy, or urgency, contrasting sharply with the chaotic crowds of anger or the panic of fear.
archetypes.visual_elements: airport terminal, rolling luggage, illuminated corridors, waiting travelers, everyday expressions
archetypes.text_query: A wide-angle architectural photograph documents a modern airport terminal with travelers pulling rolling luggage calmly through the brightly illuminated corridors, waiting patiently at boarding gates with neutral, everyday expressions.

archetypes.name: Catalog-style Object
archetypes.core_difference: Focuses on the geometric and textural reality of a mundane item, avoiding any narrative context, decay (disgust), or destruction (anger).
archetypes.visual_elements: ceramic coffee mug, white surface, softbox lighting, smooth texture, geometric shape, macro photograph
archetypes.text_query: A pristine macro photograph displays a standard ceramic coffee mug resting on a clean white surface, perfectly illuminated by softbox lighting to highlight the smooth texture and simple geometric shape of the everyday object.

archetypes.name: Informational Graphic
archetypes.core_difference: Presents purely structural digital information, entirely circumventing organic emotion by displaying abstract UI elements and data completely devoid of affective tone.
archetypes.visual_elements: digital screenshot, web dashboard, bar chart, blue typography, navigation menu, white background
archetypes.text_query: A high-resolution digital screenshot presents a clean, minimalist web dashboard featuring a basic bar chart, uniform blue typography, and a straightforward navigation menu laid out on a sterile white background for data visualization.

archetypes.name: Routine Activity
archetypes.core_difference: Highlights mundane physical maintenance without expressive reaction, completely lacking the smiles of joy or the defeated posture of sadness during daily life.
archetypes.visual_elements: kitchen sink, casual clothing, washing dinner plate, natural window light, mundane chore
archetypes.text_query: Photographed with natural window light, an individual in casual clothing stands at a kitchen sink mechanically washing an ordinary ceramic dinner plate, focused entirely on the mundane household chore without expressing any distinct emotion.
